name: rackwerk-dev-tools
description: Dev-only tooling dependencies for RackWerk (the app itself ships as a single static index.html, no build step needed to run it). Currently only used by tools/build-resonator-worklet.mjs to (re)compile src/faust/resonator.dsp into src/js/core/resonator-worklet.js -- run `npm install` once, then `node tools/build-resonator-worklet.mjs` after editing the .dsp source.
